02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curiosity
keeps me
moving.

r.
STILL LEARNING
ALWAYS EXPLORING

I like the moment a difficult problem starts to make sense.

I’m a fourth-year Software Engineering student at Metropolitan University in Sylhet. Problem solving is a part of programming I enjoy, especially the process of trying an approach, understanding why it works and finding a clearer solution.

I build web projects and use coding agents as part of my development process. I work to understand the code, make informed changes and connect tools where they help the task. My interests also extend to AI, automation and game development.

Away from code, I enjoy reading, playing games and exploring new apps. I’m also working on game projects and learning more about what makes an experience engaging.
